name: Intune Hydration Kit
description: A PowerShell module that automates Microsoft Intune tenant setup by deploying 70+ security baselines, 43 dynamic groups, 24 device filters, compliance policies, app protection policies, and Conditional Access policies in a single command. Integrates OpenIntuneBaseline and supports multi-cloud environments.
keywords: how to configure new intune tenant
author: Jorge Suarez

securityCheck.aiSummary: Identified select security considerations in token handling and supply-chain risk. Primary concerns are (1) plaintext token handling via ConvertTo-SecureString for Graph access tokens, (2) a hardcoded default ClientId, and (3) reliance on PSGallery for module installation/publishing which ties to supply chain risk. No obfuscated code, no explicit data exfiltration, and no evident malicious patterns (reverse shells, credential theft beyond token handling, etc.) are observed in the provided snippets. Address the token handling pattern, reconsider hard-coded defaults, and tighten module sourcing to reduce risk in production deployments.
